acceptanceScope: One real egress, ordinary same-map movement/AOI and the explicitly declared combat subgroup

navigationCoordination.scope: Native tool-local conservative union of original AOI obstacles, active controlled owner receipts and one in-flight movement hint per connection; never authoritative occupancy, snapshots or AOI.
navigationCoordination.blockedOpportunityRule: A conflicting prepared move is still an offered navigation-blocked/native opportunity; original cadence, completion and correction gates remain.

nativePatrolPlanning.scope: Native primed patrol fallback only; original fast path and at most four existing corner targets remain.
nativePatrolPlanning.selectionRule: Prefer the first existing collision-aware path with two legal collinear Run steps; otherwise retain the original first Walk.
nativePatrolPlanning.primingRule: Only while native Run priming is active; original cadence, transfer/coverage checks and offered-opportunity accounting remain.

attackResults.rule: No legacy fallback. Activity attacks count correlated launched outcomes only; hits still require the original dual-end damage/health evidence. Hunting attempts are offered requests, not launched attacks.

error: Continuous activity window failed, regardless of the measured stage
safetyReason: Continuous activity window failed, regardless of the measured stage

firstFailure.reason: Continuous activity window failed, regardless of the measured stage

nativeActivity.coverageFailureMeaning: Insufficient native offered/completed load is not, by itself, proof of server overload

continuousAcceptance.shortSegmentRule: Under 20 active seconds: protocol/latency/error gates still apply; no activity-rate claim

density.scope: Observed independent maxima at nominal 1000ms sampling cadence, not exhaustive peaks. total counts snapshot.entities; groundDropsReported counts snapshot.groundDrops separately and is not added to total. Maxima may come from different observers.

bytesDefinition: Physical WebSocket payload bytes, including catalog batch/gzip headers and excluding WebSocket/TLS framing

nativeLoadScope.nativeVsZoneFloorDifference: Native 550ms floor and Zone 600ms floor remain unchanged; this driver respects both
nativeLoadScope.evidenceWaitMeaning: Instrumentation wait stays in offered-load denominator; insufficient coverage does not establish server overload
nativeLoadScope.ambiguousAttackRule: Unverified attacks permanently quarantine that actor/target pair for this run; more than 64 such targets stops the test
nativeLoadScope.continuousRunningRule: The Run ratio and cell-rate gates also apply throughout ramp, anchor travel and ordinary login-window waits
limitations: No caster AOE, summons or cross-map raid proof
No simultaneous auth burst or automatic revival

combatScenario.rule: First reach the declared home by ordinary Walk/Run, then hunt; initial transit stays in continuous activity and stage measurement starts only after arrival
combatScenario.huntingRangeMeaning: Actual attack positions; chasing may leave the initial home. Authored spawns do not prove live target supply

movementCorrection.rule: First correction per uninterrupted movement streak; unchanged-owner Walk temporarily avoids its single refused cell without changing failure accounting

navigationBlocked.rule: First blocked action opportunity until a successful movement acknowledgement; ordinary blocked opportunities remain counted

selfTransform.rule: Only public packets changing owner coordinates; fixed position/direction fields streamed through the existing writer, no retained aggregate

playerLifecycle.movementRule: Ordinary movement is not copied; retain only the first known-player movement while its projection is absent, until reappearance
